source_sha_policy: A release is production only after the exact immutable source revision passes the release gate, deploys successfully and is independently observed on the canonical domain.

data_contract.policy: Evidence before amplification; every metric requires a dated snapshot; response analysis distinguishes engagement, discussion, external framing and verified owner exports; raw commenter identity is minimized.

blockers.evidence: The job reports no steps and the logs endpoint returns BlobNotFound. This is outside the static-site release artifact.

release_intent: Publish the current canonical homepage and all critical surfaces as a richer, more personal, visually varied and functionally intact Igor Vepretski experience.
promotion_gate: Do not set status to PRODUCTION until the deployment completes and the canonical domain, critical routes, assets and release metadata are verified against the same source revision.
rollback: Provider deployment history and previous source commits remain available for rollback.
